products.name: StarTech.com 42U 2-Post Open Frame Server Rack (2POSTRACK42)

products.keywords: startech horizontal cable manager finger duct 1u raceway patch cords

products.name: StarTech.com 1U Rack Blank Panel (BLANKB1)
products.summary: 1U solid black blanking panel for 19-inch server racks and cabinets.

products.name: StarTech.com 1 m OM4 LC-LC Multimode Fiber Cable (450FBLCLC1)
products.summary: 1 m aqua OM4 50/125 duplex LC-LC multimode fiber jumper, LSZH, rated to 100 Gbps.

products.keywords: startech om4 fiber lc lc multimode patch cable 10g 40g 100g aqua

products.name: StarTech.com 1 m 10G SFP+ Passive DAC Cable (SFP10GPC1M)

products.keywords: startech sfp+ dac twinax direct attach 10gbe 1m passive copper

products.name: StarTech.com 1 m 40G QSFP+ to 4x SFP+ Breakout DAC (QSFP4SFPPC1M)
products.summary: 1 m passive QSFP+ to 4x SFP+ breakout twinax cable: one 40G port to four 10G ports.
products.description: The QSFP4SFPPC1M is an MSA-compliant, uncoded passive copper breakout cable with one 40 Gbps QSFP+ connector fanning out to four 10 Gbps SFP+ connectors. It is 1 m of 30 AWG twinax with a PVC jacket.
products.keywords: startech qsfp+ breakout dac 40g to 4x10g sfp+ fanout

products.name: StarTech.com 3 m 10G SFP+ Active Optical Cable (SFP10GAOC3M)
products.summary: 3 m SFP+ to SFP+ active optical cable for 10 GbE, Cisco SFP-10G-AOC3M compatible.

products.name: StarTech.com 1 m Cat6a Shielded Snagless Patch Cable (6ASPAT1MBK)

products.name: Fluke Networks LinkIQ Cable+Network Tester (LIQ-100)
products.summary: Touchscreen cable qualifier to 10 Gb/s with PoE verification, switch diagnostics and 305 m length.
products.description: The LinkIQ Cable+Network Tester validates cable performance up to 10 Gb/s using frequency-based measurements and a wire map, measures length to 305 m (1000 ft) with distance to faults, and runs ping and nearest-switch diagnostics. Ethernet Alliance-certified PoE testing reports class 1-8 and load-tests available power.
products.keywords: fluke networks linkiq cable tester 10g poe qualifier liq-100

products.name: Fluke Networks Versiv DSX-8000 CableAnalyzer Certifier Kit
products.summary: Versiv copper certifier to Cat 8 / 2 GHz; Cat 6A certification in 8 seconds.
products.description: The DSX-8000 CableAnalyzer certifies twisted-pair cabling from Cat 5e to Cat 8 / Class I/II up to 2000 MHz for deployments up to 40 Gigabit Ethernet, completing a Cat 6A autotest in 8 seconds. It is part of the modular Versiv platform, which also accepts fiber OLTS, OTDR and inspection modules.
products.keywords: fluke networks dsx-8000 versiv cable certifier cat8 cat6a certification

specs.ports: Twisted-pair via permanent link / channel adapters

products.name: Fluke Networks MicroScanner PoE Cable Verifier Kit (MS-POE-KIT)
products.summary: Cable verifier that shows PoE class 0-8, available services to 10G, wiremap and length on one screen.
products.description: The MicroScanner PoE reports the maximum 802.3af/at/bt PoE class (0-8) a switch can provide, passive PoE voltage, available Ethernet services up to 10G, cable length, wiremap and distance to fault on one screen; it is Ethernet Alliance Gen2 PoE certified. The MS-POE-KIT adds an IntelliTone Pro 200 probe, remote IDs #2-7, patch cords, a magnetic strap and a carry case.
products.keywords: fluke networks microscanner poe cable verifier kit intellitone

specs.toolType: Cable verifier with PoE test and toner

products.name: Sysracks 12U 24 in Deep Wall-Mount Enclosure (SRW 12.600 G)
products.summary: 12U, 24-inch-deep grey wall-mount cabinet with glass door and removable locking side panels.
products.description: The Sysracks SRW 12.600 G is a 12U, 24 x 24 in wall-mount 19-inch enclosure in grey with a glass front door, push lock, brush cable inlet and lockable, removable side and rear panels. Rails with U-marking adjust up to 20 in apart and included feet let it stand on the floor.
products.keywords: sysracks 12u wall mount cabinet 24 inch deep glass door grey
